# Sharewood Forest

> Sharewood Forest (https://sharewoodforest.app) is a free-to-visit web app for giving tokens, tokenized stocks and ETH as a gift. The sender picks what to give, writes a short dedication, and seals it into a smart contract. The sender gets a private link; the recipient opens it with any Ethereum-compatible wallet. If the gift isn't opened before it expires, the sender can take it back.

Sharewood Forest is independent. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Robinhood. Nothing on the site is financial advice, and tokenized stocks are not available in every country.

## How it works
- Connect a wallet, tap the tokens or stocks to give (with logos), enter amounts, add a "To", "From" and message, and choose how long the recipient has to open it (7 days to 1 year).
- Seal and send: the contents are held by the SharewoodGifts smart contract. A gift certificate with a serial number is created for the recipient as a keepsake.
- Share the link. The key that opens the gift is after the "#" in the URL, so it is never sent to a server. Anyone with the full link can open the gift, so share it only with the recipient.
- The recipient opens the link, connects a wallet and taps "Open gift". The sender can optionally cover the network fee so opening is free for the recipient.
- Unopened gifts can be taken back by the sender after they expire.

## Wallet safety
- Sharewood Forest never asks for a seed phrase or a wallet private key.
- There is no copy-and-paste of wallet details in the main flows: users connect a wallet and approve actions inside their wallet app. Adding an unlisted token by contract address is an optional advanced control.
- The page loads its one wallet library (ethers v6) from cdnjs with a pinned Subresource Integrity hash.

## Networks and status
- Built for Robinhood Chain, Base and Arbitrum.
- As of 2026-10-09 the app is running on test networks (Robinhood Chain Testnet, Base Sepolia). Mainnet contracts are not yet announced; check the network menu in the app for what is live.
- SharewoodGifts test contract (Base Sepolia and Robinhood Chain Testnet): 0xE9712892aB4607510BCb545f1B1377b69f6AE589
  - https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0xE9712892aB4607510BCb545f1B1377b69f6AE589
  - https://explorer.testnet.chain.robinhood.com/address/0xE9712892aB4607510BCb545f1B1377b69f6AE589
